definition: Looks finished with nothing but the type scale and spacing. No assets, no rendering engine.
examples: inside the quick, standard and premium dials

definition: Typography plus drawn primitives: icons, rules, cards, RAG dots.
examples: family defaults: comparison tables, icon rows, pricing, Harvey ball, executive summary, simple chevrons

prefLabel: Level 3 - Chart engine or supplied photo
definition: Needs a real chart engine or a supplied photograph, and is alignment-sensitive.
examples: family defaults: numbers (bar, line, pie, waterfall, scatter), timeline, Gantt, image and text, team grid, logo grid

prefLabel: Level 4 - Curated imagery or multi-element diagram
definition: Needs curated high-resolution imagery or a hand-composed multi-element diagram.
examples: family defaults: full-bleed photo, photo 3-up, device mockups, maps, org chart, trees, journey map, Marimekko, dashboards

definition: Bespoke illustration or infographic, animation, video, or a live embed.
examples: family defaults: infographic, pictograph, word cloud, full video, webview, ROI calculator, iceberg and onion metaphors
